summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 4,489,421 treasury shares (0.15% of share capital) on Euronext Milan from July 20-24, 2026, at a weighted average price of €22.2746 per share, total consideration ~€100 million. This is the second tranche of a buyback program approved May 6, 2026, aimed at providing additional shareholder remuneration beyond dividends. Cumulative since May 8: 43,640,850 shares (1.44%) for ~€960 million. Post-purchase, Eni holds 130,468,957 shares (4.31%). The program is an open-market issuer tender-like capital return. Watch for program completion vs. authorization limits; no regulatory clock or advisor named.
